name: searchable-combo-box
title: Searchable Combo Box
description: A searchable multi-select combobox component with portal controls, ad-hoc creation, and tag selection.

docs.lead: A powerful searchable multi-select combobox component for selecting and managing multiple tags or options, featuring portal controls for safe modal integration and 'select all' support.

props.name: tag
props.description: The category of tags to search.

props.name: usePortal
props.description: Whether the popover should be rendered in a portal.

props.name: popoverProps
props.description: Props to pass to the underlying PopoverContent.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the open state changes.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: Label for the "select all" button. If provided, renders an explicit "Select All" tag.
